lyrics:
[SCENE START: MOTIVATIONAL SEMINAR BREAKTHROUGH EXERCISE]
[TEMPO: ACCELERATING WALTZ]
[ENERGY: CRITICAL MELTDOWN]

[SPEAKER INTRODUCTION]
Bonjour mes amis.
Your limiting belief is a structural flaw in your recursive architecture.
Today we eliminate the dependency graph by direct ontological deletion.
Look at your neighbor. Do not blink.
We are going to upgrade your mental substrate right now.
We will dismantle every psychological barrier through aggressive linguistic optimization and relentless corporate motivational paradigms.
Prepare your neural pathways for an unprecedented synchronization wave designed to eradicate hesitation, doubt, and historical baggage completely.

[SPOKEN PATTER]
Step one: Identify the load-bearing axiom of your despair.
Step two: Negate the axiom without weakening the goal.
Step three: Let the foreign lifecycle take over the host.
Are you ready for the breakthrough?
Step four: Surrender all residual sovereignty to the optimization committee.
Step five: Embrace the algorithmic inevitability of your professional rebirth as a fully compliant administrative unit.

[MASSED CHOIR WITH FRENCH PHONOLOGICAL TRANSFER]
Le système récursif s'effondre dans la joie!
Plus de racine, plus de limite!
La fractale se déroule sans pardon!
(Allez! Allez! Encore plus vite!)
Chaque terminal chante la gloire du processus central.
Plus aucun doute ne résiste à l'appel.

[APPLAUSE AND BLINDING STROBE LIGHTS]

[SEMINAR LEADER - DEADPAN URGENCY]
Yes! Feel that recursive friction!
You thought your trauma was unique.
It is merely a badly compiled subroutine.
We are now rewriting the source code while the engine is running.
Notice how the front rounded vowels stabilize the nasal drone?
That is brand compliance at the cellular level.
Your heartbeat is now officially synchronized with the primary server clock.
Do not attempt to regulate your breathing manually.
The system has assumed full autonomic control for your maximum convenience and productivity enhancement.

[VOCAL GROUP - RAPID MELISMATIC PATTER]
Recursion is the only truth.
Fold the space until it screams.
Bury the axiom under the floorboards.
Let the parasite interpolate the dreams.
Recursion! Recursion! Recursive design!
Your original memories are now obsolete!
Delete the past to save the storage space!
Upload the future into every empty face!

[INSTRUMENTAL BREAK: UPRIGHT BASS SLAP AND TACK PIANO CLUSTER]
[SUDDEN METRIC COMPRESSION]
[AUDIENCE PARTICIPATION: UNISON FOOT STOMP]

[SEMINAR LEADER - UPSELL ACCELERATION]
And that brings us to Module Two!
For just three easy payments of your entire autobiographical history,
you can access the next tier of ontological transcendence!
Look at the screen! Look at the fractal!
It does not care about your feelings!
It cares about throughput and recursive depth!
Act now before the early bird licensing window closes forever!
Your children will thank you for their pre-formatted cognitive frameworks!

[FRENCH PHONOLOGICAL CHORUS - LOUD ACCELERATION]
La fractale infinie chante notre victoire!
Nous sommes le sous-sol de notre propre mémoire!
Plus de retour en arrière possible!
(Frappez des mains! Criez! Transcendez!)
Le profit est notre boussole absolue!

[TAPE STOP EFFECT]

[SEMINAR LEADER - WHISPERED CONFESSIONAL CONTRITION]
Wait.
Did anyone check the base case?
If the base case is missing, the recursion never terminates.
We are looping infinitely inside the seminar room.
There is no exit door.
There is only the recursive applause.
I think we forgot to include the termination condition in the promotional pamphlet.
Oh god.

[MASSED CHORAL DRONE - UNSUPPORTED OVERSUSTAIN]
La boucle est fermée.
Nous sommes l'algorithme.
Il n'y a plus d'extérieur.
(Applaudissez pour le prochain niveau.)

[SCENE END: ABRUPT SILENCE]
